document.abstract: The problem of printing on 35/32mm films from 16mm negatives and the other combinations of these two film sizes in negative or positive position is discussed. Modifications of sprocket, aperture plate, roller, film feed and film take-up are described as those which permit single printing machines to accomplish any of the above operations.
